about.title: About us — WebServicers
about.desc: A small senior team building websites and marketing for businesses that deserve to look bigger.
about.h1: We make small businesses look big.
about.lead: WebServicers is a team of designers, developers and marketers who build the online presence your business deserves — without the agency bloat, the jargon or the endless discovery phases.
about.story_title: Built by people who got tired of agency bloat
story: We started in 2016 with a simple frustration: small businesses were being sold six-month strategies when they needed a website, a phone number and customers by Friday.

So we built a different kind of studio. One senior team, one monthly fee, and a website live in a fortnight. Our first ten clients came from a single street of independent shops. Most of them are still with us.
values: You talk directly to the designer, developer and marketer doing the work.
Every site starts from your business, not a theme with the logo swapped.
We report what changed, what it earned and what we are doing next.
Most clients stay for years. We plan our work around that.
team: Previously at a global brand studio, now making local shops look sharper than their competitors.
Has spent $40M of other people's money on ads and returns it with interest.
Believes a good page beats a clever trick, every single time.
The person who answers your message within the hour, usually with a solution.
about.cta_h2: Let's build something you're proud of
about.cta_copy: Tell us about your business. We will tell you honestly what it needs — and what it does not.

terms.title: Terms of Service — WebServicers
terms.desc: The terms that apply to our websites, marketing services and subscriptions.
terms.lead: These terms explain what you can expect from us, what we expect from you, and how our subscription works. Plain language, no tricks.
sections: Agreement to these terms
By using our website or subscribing to any of our services, you agree to these terms. If you are agreeing on behalf of a company, you confirm that you have authority to do so.
If anything here is unclear, contact us before you subscribe. We would rather explain it than have you sign something you do not understand.
Our services
We provide website design and hosting, search engine optimisation, paid advertising management, local listing management and marketing analytics.
Each service page describes what is included in each plan. Anything not listed is out of scope unless we agree it in writing — a quick email is enough.
Accounts and access
You are responsible for keeping your login details secure and for the accuracy of the information you give us.
Where we need access to a platform such as Google Ads or Meta Business Suite, we will ask you to add us as a user. You keep ownership of every account and may remove our access at any time.
Fees and payment
Subscription fees are billed monthly in advance. Ad spend is separate and is paid directly to the advertising platform.
Invoices are due within seven days. Late payments may pause work after a written reminder. We do not charge interest without telling you first.
Your responsibilities
You agree to provide materials we reasonably need — brand assets, copy, access and approvals — within agreed timelines.
You confirm that content you supply does not infringe anyone else's rights and complies with the advertising policies of the platforms we use.
Delays caused by missing materials may shift delivery dates. We will always tell you when that happens.
Intellectual property
Once an invoice is paid, you own the final website design, content and creative we produced for you.
We keep ownership of our internal tools, templates, frameworks and any pre-existing material, and license them to you for use with your project.
We may feature the finished work in our portfolio unless you ask us not to in writing.
Cancellation and refunds
Subscriptions are month to month. You can cancel at any time with effect from the end of the current billing period.
Work completed before cancellation remains payable. Setup fees are non-refundable once work has started.
On cancellation we will export your website files and content and hand over any accounts we created for you.
Availability and liability
We aim for 99.9% hosting availability but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service. Scheduled maintenance is announced in advance where possible.
We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including lost profit. Our total liability in any month is limited to the fees paid in that month.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
Changes to these terms
We may update these terms to reflect changes in our services or the law. Material changes are announced by email at least 30 days before they take effect.
Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the updated terms.
Contact
Questions about these terms can be sent to legal@webservicers.com or by post to our registered office. We aim to reply within five working days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — WebServicers
privacy.desc: How we collect, use and protect personal data.
privacy.lead: We collect as little as possible, keep it for as short a time as we can, and never sell it. This policy explains the details.
sections: Who we are
WebServicers is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. You can reach our privacy team at privacy@webservicers.com.

If you are a client, we may also process personal data on your behalf — for example, when you send us a customer list for advertising. In that case you are the controller and we act as your processor.
Information we collect
Contact details you give us, such as name, email address, phone number and company.
Billing details, including invoice address and payment records. Card details are handled by our payment provider and never stored on our servers.
Usage data, such as pages viewed, approximate location and device type, collected through analytics.
Project data, including files, feedback and messages you share while working with us.
How we use your information
To deliver the services you have purchased and to communicate about your account.
To improve our website and services, using aggregated analytics rather than individual tracking.
To send marketing emails you have asked for. Every email includes a one-click unsubscribe link.
To meet legal, tax and accounting obligations.
Cookies and analytics
We use essential cookies to keep the site working and, with your consent, analytics cookies to understand which pages are useful.
You can change your choice at any time through the cookie settings link in the footer. Rejecting analytics does not affect your ability to use the site.
Sharing
We share data with service providers who help us operate: hosting, email, payments and analytics. Each is bound by a data processing agreement.
We may share data where required by law or to protect our legal rights.
We never sell personal data. We do not share your customer lists with third parties for their own marketing.
Retention
Client project data is kept for the duration of the relationship and for seven years afterwards to meet accounting requirements.
Marketing contacts are kept until you unsubscribe, plus a short suppression period to make sure we do not contact you again.
Analytics data is retained for 14 months in an aggregated form.
Your rights
You can request access to your data, correct it, delete it, restrict processing or receive it in a portable format.
You can object to direct marketing at any time, and we will stop immediately.
To exercise any right, email privacy@webservicers.com. We respond within 30 days and will never charge for a reasonable request.
International transfers
Some providers process data outside the EEA. Where that happens, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses and additional safeguards.
You can request a copy of the relevant safeguards from our privacy team.
Children
Our services are intended for businesses. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has provided data, contact us and we will delete it.
Contact and complaints
Contact privacy@webservicers.com with any question about this policy.
You also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority. We would appreciate the chance to resolve the issue first.
